title: Asthma Step-up Therapy Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Step up treatment only after checking adherence, inhaler technique, trigger exposure, and diagnostic confidence.
Escalate from low-dose controller therapy in a structured stepwise manner based on control and exacerbation burden.
De-escalate cautiously only after sustained control and clear follow-up planning.

title: Long-term Oxygen Therapy Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Confirm chronic qualifying hypoxemia with stable measurements before prescribing long-term home oxygen.
Document flow targets, expected duration, and smoking/fire safety counseling whenever LTOT is prescribed.
Reassess oxygen requirement after clinical stabilization rather than assuming indefinite need.

title: Dialysis Adequacy Kt/V Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Assess delivered dialysis dose against target adequacy thresholds rather than using session duration alone.
Review access function, blood-flow limitations, adherence, and treatment time when adequacy is low.
Trend adequacy longitudinally so recurrent subtarget dialysis prompts plan adjustment.
